name: The Price Of Flesh
source:
You begin the game in an auction, and you are what's being sold. You can choose one of three paths, being sold to one of three bidders.

Mason: If you are bought by Mason, you'll be taken off the grid, deep into the dark Canadian wilderness. Mason's goal is a good hunt and you are his prize. On this path you'll not only be dealing with Mason, but the mountain itself, and all the danger upon it. You'll need survival skills, and to keep your wits about you. You'll need to manage your health, the freezing temperature, and the onset of insanity to have a chance of surviving.

Celia: If Celia buys you, you'll be taken to the basement floors of an abandoned office building. Celia is a bit high strung, and she's looking for a way to relax. Unfortunately, her preferred methods of unwinding are a bit violent. One wrong move and you may lose your life. Her path is more psychological, and you'll need to be smart and stealthy to stay alive. Unfortunately, there's no way to tell time underground- and you'll never know when she's going to come back.

Derek: Derek belongs to a sort of 'club'. If he's the one to purchase you, then you'll find out what this club is all about. In the middle of the desert, five killers bring five victims- including you. Not only will you have five murderers to contend with, but you'll have to worry about the searing heat of the desert. There's no food and no water, and the clocking is ticking for your own survival- and that of the other four victims. You may need to work together if you want to make it out alive.

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1940040/]Steam[/url]]
translation:
你在拍卖中开始游戏，你就是被出售的东西。你可以选择三种路径之一，将其出售给三个投标人之一。

梅森：如果你被梅森买下，你就会脱离电网，深入加拿大黑暗的荒野。梅森的目标是一次精彩的狩猎，而你就是他的战利品。在这条路上，你不仅要面对梅森，还要面对这座山本身，以及山上的所有危险。你需要生存技能，并保持头脑清醒。你需要管理你的健康、冰冻温度和精神错乱的发作，才有生存的机会。

西莉亚：如果西莉亚买下了你，你就会被带到一栋废弃办公楼的地下室。西莉亚有点紧张，她正在寻找放松的方法。不幸的是，她喜欢的放松方法有点暴力。一个错误的举动，你可能会失去生命。她的道路更加心理化，你需要聪明和隐秘才能生存。不幸的是，在地下没有办法看时间——你永远不知道她什么时候会回来。

德里克：德里克属于某种“俱乐部”。如果他是买下你的人，那么你就会知道这个俱乐部的意义所在。在沙漠中央，五名杀手带来了五名受害者——包括你。你不仅要对付五个凶手，还要担心沙漠的酷热。没有食物和水，你和其他四名受害者的生存已经迫在眉睫。如果你想活下来，你可能需要共同努力。

[来自[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1940040/]Steam[/url]]
